verdict.rationale: Mastra's own docs say its agent harness includes recurring schedules, that events can start workflow runs, and that agent threads can subscribe to webhook or polling events. That is first-party support for scheduled and event-triggered background automation. Each capability gets only a one-line mention, though, with no detail on how it runs unattended. Missing for 10: documentation of schedule configuration and durable background execution, evidence of how autonomous runs are monitored or managed, and any independent or hands-on corroboration of background automations working.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: create a general-purpose agent harness with a local workspace, shell tools, memory, task tracking, web access, and recurring schedules
Each event can be used to start a workflow run
Subscribe agent threads to external resources and route webhook or polling events into notification signals.
